description_en: Sets a quota for a fileset
kebab_example: aliyun nas set-fileset-quota --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya0000 --fset-id fset-1902718ea0ae0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetFilesetQuota

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CPFS for Lingjun file system. The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****. You can call DescribeFileSystems (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describefilesystems) (FileSystemType=bmcpfs) to query existing file systems.

CPFS for Lingjun file systems with the bmcpfs- prefix cannot be created by calling the CreateFileSystem operation. You must create them in the console
parameters.help_zh:
CPFS智算版文件系统ID。必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****。可通过 DescribeFileSystems (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describefilesystems?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-27516.d_0)（FileSystemType=bmcpfs）查询已有文件系统。

bmcpfs- 前缀的 CPFS 智算版文件系统暂不支持通过 CreateFileSystem API 创建，需通过控制台获取
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this request. A dry run checks parameter validity and dependencies without actually deleting the instance or incurring fees.

Valid values:

true: Sends a dry run request without deleting the export directory. The check items include required parameters, request format, and business limit dependencies. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, HTTP status code 200 is returned.

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the instance is directly deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次删除请求执行预检。
预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、依赖条件等，并不会实际删除实例，也不会产生费用。

取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除导出目录。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制依赖条件。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200HttpCode。

false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The file count limit for the quota. Valid values:

Minimum value: 10,000.

Maximum value: 10,000,000,000.

If this parameter is not specified, the file count is unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
Quota文件数量限制。取值范围：

最小值：10,000。

最大值：10,000,000,000。

该参数不填代表文件数量无限制
parameters.name: file_count_limit

parameters.help_en:
The total capacity limit for the quota. Unit: bytes.

Valid values:

Minimum value: 10,737,418,240 (10 GiB).

Increment: 1,073,741,824 (1 GiB).

If this parameter is not specified, the capacity is unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
Quota 总容量限制。单位：Byte。

取值范围：

最小值：10,737,418,240（10 GiB）。

步长：1,073,741,824（1 GiB）。

该参数不填代表容量无限制
parameters.name: size_limit
